rules.message: Formal conversion must use --source-dir --main-html --screen-id --bundle.
rules.fixAction: Use a source package for formal runs. Keep --input runs debugOnly=true.

rules.message: Formal pass requires Cocos Editor screenshot final gate.
rules.fixAction: Provide --editor-screenshot and --capture-protocol, or mark the run debugOnly.

rules.message: Formal pass requires syncing final JSON into runtime ui-spec paths.
rules.fixAction: Remove --no-runtime-sync for formal runs. Debug runs must keep debugOnly=true.

rules.message: Tabbed HTML must have per-tab replay fragments from the same run.
rules.fixAction: Enable per-tab replay and ensure each tab writes a fragment JSON before runtime sync.

rules.message: Core converter/workflow/validator must not hardcode one screen fixture.
rules.fixAction: Move fixture-specific checks into tests/fixtures or derive names from source data.

rules.message: Strict replay must not copy raw sidecars back into final output.
rules.fixAction: Fail with a blocker and repair the converter/source-derived output instead.

rules.message: Formal readiness must not fall back to <screenId>-default skin.
rules.fixAction: Sync screen.skin to the current converted skin and remove default fallback paths.

rules.message: Final gates must read synced runtime JSON, not raw/optimized/default drafts.
rules.fixAction: Run runtime sync and point readiness/final compare at assets/resources/ui-spec runtime paths.

rules.message: Formal flow requires source CSS and design tokens.
rules.fixAction: Put ui-design-tokens.json and colors_and_type.css in the source package.

rules.message: Tab id, fragment, mount and childPanelClass must be derived from data/contract, not hardcoded.
rules.fixAction: Derive routing from HTML attributes, content contracts, screen package, or naming policy.

rules.message: svg-radar-chart hint must include source SVG geometry payload.
rules.fixAction: Emit viewBox, center, axisLines, gridPolygons, valuePolygon, labels and textBox.

rules.message: New draft-builder behavior must be attached to a registered stage/rule.
rules.fixAction: Register the stage/rule in draftBuilderStageRules before adding conversion logic.

rules.message: Plan4 used to require SKILL.md to point at Plan4 as current execution spec.
rules.fixAction: Use H2U-P5-001 for current execution-spec and registry-source checks.

rules.message: Semantic classifiers must not use bare substring matches that let history match story.
rules.fixAction: Replace bare /story/ style checks with token-aware, attribute-aware, or contract-aware classification.

rules.message: story-strip slots must come from explicit attributes/contracts or multiple independent signals.
rules.fixAction: Require explicit story-strip attributes or multi-signal evidence before emitting slot.story-strip.

rules.message: Gradient/image backgrounds must not silently downgrade to flat colors.
rules.fixAction: Preserve backgroundLayers or emit a visualFidelityRisk blocker for unsupported layers.

rules.message: Radial gradients must preserve geometry/stops or become blocker/assetization-required.
rules.fixAction: Emit radial gradient metadata with stops/center/radius, or mark unsupportedLayerRisk as blocker.

rules.message: Interaction sidecars must be executed in Preview runtime, not only copied as JSON.
rules.fixAction: Bind final synced interaction/tab-routing sidecars in runtime and record interactionRuntime smoke results.

rules.message: Primary visual risk must block formal pass even if CSS coverage is high.
rules.fixAction: Add visualFidelityRisk to the summary and require blockerCount=0 before formal pass.

rules.message: Formal runtime sync must not use raw sidecars as final authority.
rules.fixAction: Copy only final sidecars in formal runtime sync; fail with a blocker when final sidecars are missing.

rules.message: Formal final gate capture target must match the converted screenId.
rules.fixAction: Use the formal UIScreenPreviewHost capture route and compare only screenshots whose actualScreenId equals the workflow screenId.

rules.message: Formal capture must carry uiVersion/runtimeVersion and runtime spec hashes.
rules.fixAction: Run capture after runtime sync and include uiVersion plus screen/layout/skin hashes in capture-report.json.

rules.message: Legacy product preview targets must not be used as HTML-to-UCUF formal gate captures.
rules.fixAction: Use capture-ui-screens.js --formal-screen-id <screenId> instead of --target Gacha/GachaMain style aliases.

rules.message: Source package resolver must find shared token/CSS roots when --source-dir points at a screen folder.
rules.fixAction: Promote the authority root to the nearest ancestor containing ui-design-tokens.json and colors_and_type.css, and record the promotion in the manifest.

rules.message: Every workflow run must regenerate screen-local tokens in replace-all-per-run mode; incremental accumulation is forbidden.
rules.fixAction: Ensure tokenGovernance.mode === replace-all-per-run in the workflow summary.

rules.message: Every workflow run must produce a screen-local token diff report with added/removed/persisted counts.
rules.fixAction: Ensure tokenGovernance.diffReportPath is present and the diff report file exists.

rules.message: Screen-local tokens that qualify for promotion must be promoted to global tokens before formal pass.
rules.fixAction: Promote eligible tokens in ui-design-tokens.json or add a formal promotion waiver.

rules.message: Expired literal-color waivers must be resolved before formal pass.
rules.fixAction: Remove the expired waiver and either promote the token or fix the source HTML to use a mapped token.

rules.message: Current roadmap is the current execution spec and rule-registry.json is the single rule source of truth.
rules.fixAction: Update SKILL.md to point to docs/html-to-ucuf/current-roadmap.md as current execution spec and to reference tools_node/lib/html-to-ucuf/rule-registry.json as the authoritative rule registry.

rules.message: Stale-rule audit must classify old rules as remove, migrate, keep, or blocker.
rules.fixAction: Emit a stale-rule audit artifact in the workflow summary and classify every legacy rule path before formal pass.

rules.message: Cocos final gate score below 0.95 must fail the workflow and emit non-empty nextFixes.
rules.fixAction: When adjustedScore < 0.95, set workflowPass=false and add at least one actionable nextFix entry.

rules.message: High browser coverage plus low Cocos final score must emit a blocker taxonomy.
rules.fixAction: When browser adjustedCoverage >= 0.95 but Cocos adjustedScore < 0.95, record blockerTaxonomy with at least one classified cause.

rules.message: Plan5 continues the no screen-specific hardcode rule from Plan4.
rules.fixAction: Fix the underlying H2U-P4-005 violation.

rules.message: Unsupported CSS features must be surfaced through a capability matrix or blocker, not silently downgraded.
rules.fixAction: Emit explicit capability-matrix coverage for unsupported CSS features and block formal pass when unsupported features affect primary zones.

rules.message: Formal pass cannot depend on visual degradation fallback.
rules.fixAction: Record downgrade/fallback reasons as blockers or approved waivers instead of treating them as equivalent pass output.

rules.message: Source-derived raw/final/synced/runtime JSON must carry authority or freshness evidence.
rules.fixAction: Emit authority-chain hashes or freshness metadata for raw/final/synced/runtime specs in the workflow summary.

rules.message: 95% regression closure must include gacha-ds3 plus at least two non-gacha source packages.
rules.fixAction: Emit a regression matrix artifact listing at least three formal fixtures and their browser/Cocos scores.

rules.message: Compare boards and screenshots should be summarized by path and notes, not dumped as large payloads.
rules.fixAction: Keep heavy compare artifacts out of handoff text and emit only short summaries plus file paths.

rules.message: Formal pass must evaluate all four fidelity dimensions (structural/colorFill/layoutGeometry/interactionSmoke) independently; composite adjustedScore alone is insufficient.
rules.fixAction: Emit fidelityDimensions object in workflow-summary with per-dimension pass/fail; all four must be true before workflowPass=true.

rules.message: Any zone excluded from scoring must reference an exemptCategories entry (EC-*) or a knownGaps entry (KG-*); silent exemption is forbidden.
rules.fixAction: Add exemptCategoryRef or knownGapRef to the zone in zone-ownership report, or add a new KG-* entry to rule-registry.json knownGaps.

fidelityThresholds._rationale: Single adjustedScore mixes converter responsibility with platform limits. Split into 4 independent gates to assign blame correctly.

structural.note: Hard gate — any missing required node = fail, regardless of other scores

interactionSmoke.formula: all registered smoke routes return exit code 0
interactionSmoke.scope: interaction sidecar smoke routes listed in source package

compositeScore._note: Kept for backward-compat reporting; does NOT alone determine pass/fail
compositeScore.formula: Σ(zone.colorPassBit * zone.areaWeight) / Σ(zone.areaWeight) over scorable zones
compositeScore.weights: proportional to zone pixel area in formal capture screenshot

fidelityThresholds.interimNote: interim thresholds apply while PROG-2-0010 multi-fixture matrix is incomplete

exemptCategories.name: backdrop-filter
exemptCategories.reason: No native compositor pass in Cocos runtime
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Replace with opaque background layer or pre-baked asset

exemptCategories.name: box-shadow-inset-blur
exemptCategories.reason: Stencil/SDF rendering path unavailable in Cocos
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Bake shadow into sprite or use solid border (mark as knownGap)

exemptCategories.name: text-shadow-multilayer
exemptCategories.reason: Cocos Label supports single outline only
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Use pre-rendered bitmapFont with glow effect

exemptCategories.name: non-linear-gradient
exemptCategories.reason: No non-uniform gradient shader in Cocos runtime
exemptCategories.note: Once assetization-required marker present AND runtimeAssetPath bound → counts as PASS, not exempt
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Assetize to JPG/PNG at design resolution; bind via runtimeAssetPath

exemptCategories.name: pseudo-elements
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Convert to explicit child node or omit if purely decorative

exemptCategories.name: interactive-states
exemptCategories.reason: Static screenshot cannot capture interaction states
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Verify via interaction smoke test dimension instead

exemptCategories.name: font-subpixel-antialiasing
exemptCategories.scope: text rendering differences between browser FreeType/CoreText and Cocos FreeType
exemptCategories.reason: Sub-pixel rendering is engine-specific, not controllable by converter
exemptCategories.note: Text zones use deltaE <= 10 (instead of default 5) in colorFill calculation

exemptCategories.name: clip-path-complex
exemptCategories.reason: Cocos mask supports rectangle and circle only
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Redesign to use rect/circle mask, or pre-clip in sprite asset

exemptCategories.name: css-animation-transition
exemptCategories.reason: Static screenshot captures frame-0 only; full animation out of scope
exemptCategories.designGuidance: Validate animated states via Cocos animation preview separately

exemptCategories.name: overflow-scroll-off-viewport
exemptCategories.cssCondition: overflow IN [hidden, scroll] AND contentHeight > viewportHeight
exemptCategories.reason: Only first-screen (non-scrolled) content captured in formal screenshot

exemptCategories.name: webfont-glyphs
exemptCategories.scope: emoji, Noto edge cases, CJK extension characters
exemptCategories.reason: Browser and Cocos font library differ in glyph coverage for uncommon characters
exemptCategories.fallback: compare font-size, line-height, color only; skip per-glyph pixel comparison

knownGaps.description: history container 容易被 /story/ regex 誤分類；P4 已修但仍有 edge case
knownGaps.scoreImpact: structural — 最多 1 個 zone 誤分類
knownGaps.resolution: H2U-P4-014/015 active; further edge cases filed as new bugs

knownGaps.description: banner-bg-fill 1460x880 off-center radial gradient — assetization boundary confirmed
knownGaps.scoreImpact: colorFill + layoutGeometry 排除，不計分也不視為失敗
knownGaps.resolution: assetize 為 formal JPG; bind via runtimeAssetPath; 排除後 score 重算為 pass

knownGaps.description: carousel 互動目前僅 smoke test 驗，formal 不要求 100% 像素對標
knownGaps.scoreImpact: interactionSmoke dimension only; colorFill / layoutGeometry 排除
knownGaps.resolution: by design — carousel frame-0 snapshot accepted; full animation out of scope

knownGaps.description: 卡片稀有度光暈用 multi-layer text-shadow 實作；Cocos 降為 single outline
knownGaps.scoreImpact: colorFill — affected zones excluded from scoring
knownGaps.resolution: art-budget-constraint: single outline accepted; upgrade path is bitmapFont or pre-baked glow sprite
